topic: At Arlong Park, Arlong was about to kill the village sheriff Genzo, and Usopp saved him in chapter 72—a moment that established Usopp as part of Nami's story long before the crew fully formed
title: Usopp Saved Genzo When No One Else Could
description: In chapter 72, Arlong threatened the village sheriff Genzo. Usopp was hiding nearby and darted in just in time, pulling Genzo to safety before the Fish-Men could react. It was a small moment—one village save, not a legendary fight. But it changed everything about what Nami would become.
comment: Would Arlong have noticed the crew infiltrating his island if Usopp hadn't been there to make that exact save?

lines.text: In chapter 72, Arlong threatened Genzo, the village sheriff who'd just acquired a weapon.

shot.fallback: fish-man warlord threatening a vulnerable sheriff

lines.text: Usopp was the only one close enough to react. He darted in and pulled Genzo clear before the Fish-Men even saw him coming.

shot.search: Usopp saves Genzo darting in rescue
shot.fallback: hero pulling a man from danger

lines.text: One second later, Arlong would have finished him. One second earlier, and Usopp wouldn't have been in position at all.

shot.fallback: close call balanced on a knife's edge

lines.text: But Arlong noticed something it hadn't before: a strange new face interfering in his island.
That interference tipped Arlong off that his island had uninvited guests, and he suddenly started watching closer.
Without that save, Arlong would have stayed oblivious, and Nami's plan would have had way more breathing room.
One person, one moment, one save that cost Usopp nothing, but changed when Arlong started paying attention.
That's the quiet cost of keeping a sniper in your crew: sometimes the biggest impact is just being there when you're needed...
